title: Spyglass: Now Generally Available
summary: Our highly anticipated Spyglass tool has officially launched, empowering you with a new level of data understanding and visibility.

title: Enhanced File Management in the Editor
summary: We've significantly upgraded the editor to give you unparalleled control over your images and files, offering seamless management and personalized display options for all your content.

title: Our Public Product Roadmap Is Here!
summary: Our new public roadmap offers a transparent view into our development, showcasing recently shipped updates, what's next, and what's on the horizon.

title: Effortless Checkboxes
summary: Enjoy an improved experience with our newly designed checkboxes, now bigger, easier to click, and effortlessly draggable to streamline your tasks.

title: Enhanced Real-time Collaboration
summary: We've significantly enhanced our real-time collaboration tools, making it easier and more intuitive than ever to work seamlessly with your team.

title: Seamless Shared Content Access
summary: Now you can effortlessly find and leverage all content shared by your connections, making collaboration smoother and more intuitive than ever before.

title: Experience Noeko in Your Language

summary: Unlock new insights and streamline your workflow within the Constellation view by utilizing powerful filters for tags and time, alongside integrated social sharing capabilities.

title: Personalized Search and Saved Collections
summary: Unlock the full potential of your knowledge by precisely filtering, sorting, and saving your custom searches into personalized collections for instant recall and organization.

title: Flexible Content Presentation
summary: Unlock new ways to organize and interact with your notes through flexible content displays, offering quick links, concise summaries, and rich previews.

title: Vibrant New Themes & Polished Classics
summary: We're bringing a fresh look to your experience with beautifully refined existing themes and a selection of exciting new visual styles.

title: Accurate Welcome Messages
summary: We're enhancing your experience with perfectly timed greetings on the homepage, ensuring you always receive a warm and accurate welcome.

title: Streamlined Tag Management with Bulk Actions

title: Expand Your Content Horizons
